project_analysis.summary: A website showcasing UI components built with React and Tailwind CSS.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To demonstrate a collection of reusable UI components for developers.
expected_user_journey: Visit the homepage to see all available components.
Click on a component to view its documentation and examples.

smoke_tests: Verify that the homepage loads without errors.
Check if all UI components are displayed correctly.
regression_tests: Test the functionality of each component after updates or changes.
Ensure that existing examples and documentation remain accurate.
boundary_tests: Input invalid data into form fields to ensure error messages appear as expected.
negative_tests: Attempt to access non-existent components or pages to verify 404 errors.
accessibility_tests: Audit the website for compliance with WCAG standards.
integration_tests: Test interactions between different UI components.
system_tests: Verify that the website performs well under load.
ui_tests: Check the visual consistency and responsiveness of the components across devices.
functional_tests: Ensure that each component functions as intended according to its documentation.
exploratory_tests: Explore user interactions with various components to identify unexpected behaviors.
compatibility_tests: Test the website on multiple browsers and devices.
security_tests: Scan for vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection.
performance_test_suggestions: Perform a performance audit using tools like Lighthouse.
api_test_suggestions: Load test the API endpoints used by the components.

user_workflow: Viewing and interacting with UI components
